# ZefNet v2 oracle fixtures

These binary files are copied byte-for-byte from `/Users/ulf/dev/zef/crates/zefnet_message_encoding/fixtures/` on 2026-11-18, branch `zefnet-v2`.

They are generated by Zef's canonical constructors through `crates/zefnet_message_encoding/tools/generate_fixtures.py`, which also asserts that every routed fixture is a valid v2 message as defined in [[wire-format]]. They are consumed by the Rust codec's golden tests and by `test/zefnetWire.test.ts`.

The session frames (`session_*.bin`) are unchanged from protocol v1. The routed records (`data_*.bin`, `delivery_error.bin`) use the v2 envelope: version, hops, attempts, message id, target path, origin path or nil, payload.

When the Rust wire protocol changes, regenerate the Rust fixtures first, copy the corresponding files here, and update `test/zefnetWire.test.ts` before changing the TypeScript codec.
